_doc: How light and text sit on every world (src/fx/Lighting.ts, src/fx/Environment.ts, src/ui/ink.ts). lamps: a lamp (your own light, a crystal's, a building's) is stamped into the darkness layer and takes the darkness away; under a bright sky there is little darkness to take, and on pale ground (salt, snow) a lamp at full strength wiped the sky's color off the ground and left a white hole with you lost in it. So every lamp is scaled by how dark the world is: dark = 1 - brightness of the ambient color (0 full daylight .. 1 black); a lamp is at full strength once dark reaches fullDark, falls off below it by curve, and never under floor. nightSun: how much of a red dwarf's tint (planets.json sunTint) the night keeps (0 none .. 1 all); the tint is the sun's, and at full strength it turned the homeworld's night nearly black. ink: the dark edge under the game's small text (the counters, the place and who lives here, title cards, notices, what a printer waits for) so it reads on pale ground too: color, strength 0..1, and how far the store's counters fade while nothing changes (idle) or while a material stands at zero (zero).
